business_summary: Fumakilla Limited manufactures, sells, imports, and exports insecticides, household goods, gardening supplies, and commercial products worldwide. The company offers garden supplies, including fungicides, herbicides, fertilizers, plant stimulants, potting soil, and other gardening related products, as well as pest control agents and pesticides for nuisance insects; and household goods, such as pollen and house dust control, insect repellent and clothing protection agents, dehumidifier, and other home care products. It also provides pest control products for stores, factories, and restaurants for business and industry uses; and manufactures and sells emulsions, oils, powders, rodenticides, molds, and accept orders for termite control work. The company was formerly known as Oshimo Kaishundo and changed its name to Fumakilla Limited in 1962. Fumakilla Limited was founded in 1874 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.
